mapper.insert: insert into ${attSignTable} (userid, usertype, signtype, signdate, signtime, clientaddress, isincom, isimport, signfrom, longitude, latitude, addr) values (#{oaUserId}, 1, #{signType}, #{signDate}, #{signTime}, #{clientAddress}, 1, #{isImport}, #{signFrom}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{addr})
mapper.delete: delete from ${attSignTable} where userid = #{oaUserId} and signdate = #{signDate} and signfrom = #{signFrom}
mapper.select: select cast(id as varchar(64)) as sign_id, cast(userid as int) as oa_user_id, signdate as sign_date, signtime as sign_time, isnull(signdate, '') + ' ' + isnull(signtime, '') as sign_datetime, cast(signtype as int) as sign_type, isnull(signfrom, '') as sign_from from ${attSignTable} where id = #{signId}
